channel.title: The Luverne Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Luverne Journal (luvernejournal.com)

item.title: Children's Policy Council promotes ambassador program
item.description: Crenshaw County high school ambassadors help the Children’s Policy Council connect families with resources, promote youth leadership and support programs such as free books for young children.

item.title: Middle District recognizes National Human Trafficking Prevention Month
item.description: Middle District of Alabama marks National Human Trafficking Prevention Month, highlighting Homeland Security Task Forces, recent sex trafficking convictions and nationwide surge operations.

item.title: Crenshaw County Arrests Jan. 20 - 24
item.description: Crenshaw County reports arrests from Jan. 20 – 24, including multiple holds for other agencies, as well as charges of DUI, domestic violence, meth trafficking and public intoxication.

item.title: Highland Home School hosts 'Tour the Town'
item.description: Highland Home's "Tour the Town" pairs ninth-graders with second-graders in a student-led career expo highlighting literacy, STEM and future job paths.

item.title: To die in the Lord
item.description: Dean Kelly reflects on Revelation 14 and 1 Thessalonians 4, explaining the hope, blessing, and rest promised to patient, obedient Christians who “die in the Lord.”

item.title: You must decide who you are
item.description: Discover why God repeatedly called Ezekiel “son of man,” how his Babylonian exile shaped his visions of judgment and mercy, and what his message means for your faith today.

item.title: School board approves additional faculty hiring
item.description: Crenshaw County Board of Education's special meeting OKs new early learning support hires and highlights multiple open positions across the school system.

item.title: Humility Needed in the Pulpit and Pew
item.description: From music disputes to “ego on parade,” pastor Michael J. Brooks uses real church conflicts to show why humility — on the platform and in the pews — is essential to resisting spiritual harm.

item.title: Reaching for Ruth-like faith
item.description: A local pastor reflects on Ruth’s trust in God, his own struggle to match it, and the call to follow God amid uncertainty when the path ahead is unclear.

item.title: Highland Home Hardware up for sale
item.description: Highland Home Hardware on Montgomery Highway is for sale, with both buildings, full inventory and recent updates included, as the owner shifts focus to other businesses.
